title.zh: 修订第255号共和国法第2条的法案
title.en: An Act to Amend Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred Fifty-Five
title.orig: An Act to Amend Section Two of Republic Act Numbered Two Hundred Fifty-Five

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1949/ra_378_1949.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。 源文存在同号重出的条款（第 2 条）：该处官方页面确有两段均标同一 Section 号，本库照录其 `no` 值（不改动官方编号），条文 `id` 以 `_2`「_3」后缀保证唯一。

text.en:
Section two of Republic Act Numbered Two hundred fifty-five is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

The extension herein granted shall be effective if the grantee, the Cacho and Hidalgo co-partner, its successors, shall file with the Office of the of the Philippines, the acceptance in writing of the provisions of this Act not later than September thirty, nineteen hundred and forty-nine."

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 14, 1949.
